title: Just okay
text: Just okay. These tongs are really kind of large. I wasn't expecting that, but that's my fault for not ready the specs thoroughly before buying. They are useful for turning things on the grill, like corn on the cob, baked potatoes and ribs. They do feel a little flimsy though, so I'm doubtful that they will hold up very well over time.
